name: cozea/electron-app
install: curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash && export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH" && bun install && { test -f .env.local || printf 'VITE_CONVEX_URL=https://knowing-finch-546.convex.cloud\n' > .env.local; }

terminals.name: app-dev
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"; export DISPLAY=:1; export ELECTRON_DISABLE_SANDBOX=1; export COZEA_ALLOW_INSECURE_DEVICE_IDENTITY=1; bun run dev
terminals.description: Electron + Vite dev app (electron-vite dev). Renders on the Cloud Agent display :1. ELECTRON_DISABLE_SANDBOX is required because the headless VM has no SUID chrome-sandbox; COZEA_ALLOW_INSECURE_DEVICE_IDENTITY lets the collab device identity initialize without an OS keyring.
